reason: SUNSHINE announced further delays in multiple annual and interim results, along with a change of auditor and continued trading suspension, suggesting severe accounting and operational distress.
why_now: The announcement of further delays and continued suspension on August 28, 2026, highlights a critical and worsening financial situation.
